info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: This API updates specified promotional events within the marketing framework of the banking service. By providing the unique identifier 'param1', clients can modify details of existing marketing campaigns to reflect changes in strategy or offers. This API is primarily used by marketing teams and system integrators to keep promotional information current and relevant. Use cases include updating event dates, descriptions, or target audiences to enhance customer engagement and drive results.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific promotional event identified by its unique resource ID. You can modify attributes such as title, description, and date to keep your promotional event up-to-date.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the promotional event identified by RES-100045. This object contains the fields that need to be modified or updated in the existing promotional event.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
